content.comment_body: Hello, my [product_name] is locked with the administrator password and I'm unable to reset it. I read online that the default password should be [product_name], but when I enter it, I get an error. Interestingly, when uploading a program from my computer, the password is accepted, but not on the device itself.
Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. Please note that this is an English-speaking forum, and we ask you to submit your future posts in English. Thank you.

Are you referring to the password needed to change from operator mode to administrator mode? If that's the case, it can only be changed on the [product_name] device itself by entering the correct password. Alternatively, you can set a new password using [product_name] software's access control options: go to Tools > Transfer > Access Control.
Thank you very much for your reply. I've resolved the issue now.
Sorry, I usually write in English but my software automatically translates my posts into Spanish.
It seems you prefer not to post in English. That's unfortunate...

analysis.insight_summary: The user was initially unable to reset or bypass the administrator password on a [product_name] device. The default password was rejected on the hardware but accepted when programming via PC. Guidance to use the access control feature in the relevant software helped resolve the lockout issue.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expected the administrator password to work consistently both on the hardware device and through programming on the computer, and wanted to be able to reset or override the password if necessary.
